# External audio used in the internal demo

All listed downloads are marked CC0 on their linked source pages. They are stored here for the team's demo build; original filenames are noted where useful.

| Local file | Source / author | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ambient_horror.ogg` | [Ambient horror](https://opengameart.org/content/ambient-horror), techiew | Quiet looping layer under the Level 0 fluorescent hum |
| `heavy_door_open.wav` (original: `door_open.wav`) | [Door Open SFX](https://opengameart.org/content/door-open-sfx), Oiboo | Exit seam opening |
| `mechanical_clank.wav` (original: `clank1.wav`) | [Mechanical Sounds](https://opengameart.org/content/mechanical-sounds), BMacZero | Layered onto valve turns |
| `horror_hit_bassy_01.wav` (original: `Bassy 1.wav`) | [Horror Hit Soundpack 1](https://opengameart.org/content/horror-hit-soundpack-1), psychhead_ | Layered onto the mascot jumpscare |

The horror hit pack includes its own `README.txt`; its instructions and the source page identify the pack as CC0. This is a curated subset, not the full pack.

## Monster and valve recordings (2026-10-16)

- `monster_snarls_2.ogg`: **Monster snarls**, Darsycho, [source](https://opengameart.org/content/monster-snarls), CC0. Original download: `monster-snarls-2_0.ogg`. Used as the stalker voice with near-original pitch; replaces the generated creature voice.
- `valve_running_water.wav`: **Tap Water 2**, OwlStorm (credit: Ashe Kirk / Owlish Media), [source](https://freesound.org/people/OwlStorm/sounds/212176/), [CC0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). Downloaded public high-quality MP3 preview from `https://cdn.freesound.org/previews/212/212176_140737-hq.mp3`. Converted to mono PCM; excerpt 3–11 seconds, 0.3-second end crossfade, gentle dynamics compression and loudness adjustment for looping. This is edited recorded running tap water, not synthesized audio. Used for valve flow and the Level 0 water gate.
